prompts.title: 武士狙击手动态战斗场景提示
prompts.description: 一个高度详细、电影化的提示，用于生成一个动态的动漫级战斗场景：一名武士狙击手在夜晚的日本城堡屋顶上，呈俯卧射击姿势，强调超低角度构图、枪口火焰和高对比度照明。
prompts.content:
Masterpiece quality, theatrical anime-scale dynamic battle scene. A samurai character is the main subject (preserving a traditional samurai feel, optionally blended with subtle modern gear elements). Prone firing pose (low-profile/propped close to the roof surface), body flattened to the tiles, elbows braced for stability. Cheek pressed to the stock while peering through the scope, one eye narrowed, an intense focused stare and clenched teeth conveying tension and determination.

Composition and angle: the camera is placed almost on the roof tiles—an extreme ground-level ultra low-angle. Wide-angle lens with exaggerated perspective and strong depth. A diagonal composition: the sniper rifle runs from the extreme lower foreground into the midground, leading the viewer’s eye directly to the samurai’s gaze. The muzzle and muzzle flash dominate the extreme foreground, appearing oversized and close enough to “break the screen,” while the face (especially the eyes) stays crisp and sharp.

Action: captured at the exact instant of firing. A large, stylized muzzle flash erupts in the foreground; sparks, glowing embers, and thin smoke burst outward. Ejected brass and scattered casings on the tiles reinforce the sense of ongoing fire. A faint luminous streak suggests the bullet’s path slicing through the night air. Subtle recoil pushes the rifle and shoulder back; dynamic motion blur on the weapon and sleeves, while the eyes and brow remain tack-sharp. The scope glass reflects a cold blue-green sheen; metal surfaces show finely detailed reflections and crisp edge highlights.

Setting: the rooftop of a white Japanese castle keep (white plaster walls), under a clear night sky. Clean moonlight creates strong rim lighting along roof ridges and the samurai’s silhouette. Traditional roof features—curved ceramic tiles, ridge lines, gables, and shachihoko ornaments—read clearly in silhouette and detail. The firing shock and weight shift chip and crack tiles; fragments and dust jump up and arc toward the camera. High-contrast cinematic lighting with a dramatic warm–cool split: warm muzzle flash versus cool moonlight. Filmic particles (dust, embers) in the air.

Vertical cinematic poster composition, 9:16 aspect ratio, no text.

大师级品质，影院级动画规模的动态战斗场景。一名武士角色是主要描绘对象（保留传统武士风格，可选择性地融入微妙的现代装备元素）。呈卧姿射击姿态（低姿态/紧贴屋顶表面），身体平伏在瓦片上，双肘支撑以保持稳定。脸颊紧贴枪托，透过瞄准镜窥视，一只眼睛微眯，专注而紧张的凝视和紧咬的牙关传达出紧张和决心。

构图与角度：摄像机几乎放置在屋顶瓦片上——极端的超低角度。广角镜头，透视夸张，景深强烈。对角线构图：狙击步枪从极近的前景延伸至中景，将观众的视线直接引向武士的目光。枪口和枪口火焰占据极近的前景，显得硕大，近到足以“破屏而出”，而脸部（尤其是眼睛）则保持清晰锐利。

动作：捕捉到射击的精确瞬间。巨大的、风格化的枪口火焰在前景爆发；火花、炽热的余烬和稀薄的烟雾向外喷射。弹出的黄铜弹壳和散落在瓦片上的弹壳增强了持续射击的感觉。一道微弱的发光轨迹暗示着子弹划破夜空。轻微的后坐力将步枪和肩膀向后推；武器和袖子有动态模糊，而眼睛和眉毛则保持锐利。瞄准镜玻璃反射出冷冽的蓝绿色光泽；金属表面显示出精细的反射和清晰的边缘高光。

场景：白色日本城堡天守阁（白色灰泥墙）的屋顶，在晴朗的夜空下。洁净的月光在屋脊和武士的轮廓上形成强烈的轮廓光。传统的屋顶特征——弯曲的陶瓷瓦片、屋脊线、山墙和鯱（shachihoko）装饰——在剪影和细节中清晰可见。射击的冲击和重心转移使瓦片碎裂；碎片和灰尘向上飞溅并弧形飞向摄像机。高对比度的电影级照明，具有戏剧性的冷暖色调分割：温暖的枪口火焰与清冷的月光形成对比。空气中有电影般的颗粒（灰尘、余烬）。

prompts.title: 复古装饰艺术西装专题
prompts.description: 一个高度技术性的提示，用于生成一张复古装饰艺术风格的男性编辑肖像，他身穿结构化的双排扣羊毛西装外套，强调电影般的对比度以及彩色玻璃窗投射到西装和背景上的彩色光线效果。
prompts.content: Shot on a Hasselblad 907X 50C with an XCD 90mm f/2.5 lens, aperture f/2.8 shallow depth of field emphasizes the precision fit of the suit while the background dissolves into painterly color patches; captured in 16-bit RAW with high dynamic range and soft film grain to preserve wool texture and the glow of colored light without "harsh" digital sharpness. Frame a tight portrait cropped to mid-chest, at eye level, with a slight three-quarter turn; the model is offset from center so the stained-glass pattern reads in the negative space. The pose is calm and composed: shoulders open, posture confident but without tension; one hand neatly adjusts the tie knot or collar line, the other is in the trouser pocket, slightly opening the jacket and revealing the layered styling. Expression restrained and thoughtful; the gaze passes just past the lens, as if distant music is playing. Outfit a man in a suit with a retro accent: a structured double-breasted wool blazer with sharp lapels, high-waisted pleated trousers, a white shirt and narrow tie, polished Oxfords, and a minimal pocket square. Location a retro Art Deco hall with dark wood, brass, and a tall stained-glass window projecting jewel-like geometry onto the suit and background. Light warm practical fill from one side and colored stained-glass light from the other, cinematic contrast, "stained-glass" shadows. Result -retro editorial: graphic, refined, expensive, and timeless
